project_type: Monorepo with React SPA (Vite), Bun backend server, and React Native mobile app
build_system: Bun workspaces, Vite for web build, Expo for mobile
test_framework: Vitest with integration tests that hit real API endpoints
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'bun run build' in apps/web to verify production build. 2. Run 'bun run test' in apps/web to verify tests pass. 3. Run 'bun run lint' in apps/web. 4. Run 'bun run typecheck' in apps/web.
environment_constraints: Bun only (no npm). TMDB_API_KEY needed as environment variable. Frontend must never expose API keys. VidAPI only for embed player URLs.
contribution_requirements: Use Bun everywhere. Dark mode premium UI. TMDB API key in backend/edge only, never in frontend.
key_patterns: API client in src/utils/api.js uses fetchWithCache pattern with TTL from cache.js. Edge Function at apps/web/api/[...path].js proxies API. Cloudflare function at apps/web/functions/api/[[path]].js. Backend at apps/server/src/index.js with in-memory cache. Components: ContentCard, DetailHero, EpisodeList, VideoPlayer. Pages: Home, Movies, TV, Search, MovieDetail, TVDetail, Player. React Query for data fetching. Infinite scroll for lists.
directory_structure: HIJISTREAM/ - monorepo root with bun workspaces. apps/web/ - React SPA (Vite + Tailwind). apps/web/src/app/ - page components. apps/web/src/components/ - shared UI. apps/web/src/utils/ - api, cache, storage, player. apps/web/api/ - Vercel Edge Functions. apps/web/functions/ - Cloudflare Pages Functions. apps/web/tests/ - Vitest integration tests. apps/server/ - Bun backend proxy. apps/mobile/ - Expo React Native app.
